name: Boothi XII
description: Boothi XII was a planet located in the galaxy. During her time at the University of Bar'leth, Chelli Lona Aphra explored a subterranean vault on Boothi XII, hoping to discover artifacts that would further her career as an archaeologist. However, when exploring the vault, she found nothing of value.
